paite: Hiaite Noah tapa Shem, Ham leh Japheth suante ahi uh. Tuichim tun nung in tapate anei chiat uhi.
heading: Noah Tapate Suante / (1 Kro 1.5-23)
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

paite: Japheth tapate: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshek leh Tiras ahi uh.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

paite: Gomer tapate: Ashkenaz, Riphath leh Togarmah ahi uh.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

paite: Javan tapate: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim leh Dodanim ahi uh.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

paite: Huaite a kipan in Zentelte, amau pau leh amau nam dungzui zel in, amau chite omna tuikulh gam, amau gamte ah akikhenzak uhi.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

paite: Ham tapate: Kush, Mizraim, Put leh Kanaan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

paite: Kush tapate: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah leh Sabtekhah ahi uh. Raamah tapate: Sheba leh Dedan ahi uh.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

paite: Kush in tapa Nimrod anei hi. Amah leitung ah mihattak ahong hi panta hi.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

paite: TOUPA ma ah sabengmi hattak ahi a; huaiziak in ahi, "TOUPA ma a sabet hattak Nimrod bang ahi," achih zel uh.
english: He was a mighty hunter before Yahweh. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before Yahweh”.

paite: Alal patna Shinar gam a Babel khua, Erek khua, Akkad khua leh Shinar gam a Kalneh khua ahi uh.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

paite: Huai gam a kipan apawt a, Assuria gam ah alut a, Nineveh khua, Rehoboth-Ir khua leh Kalah khua asat hi.
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

paite: Nineveh leh Kalah kikal ah Resen khua asat a, huai Resen khua thupitak ahi.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

paite: Mizraim in Ludte, Anamte, Lehabte, Naphtuhte,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

paite: Pathruste leh Kasluhte, Philistiate leh Kaphtorte pawtna asuang hi.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

paite: Kanaan in tapa masa Zidon anei a, Heth leng anei lai a,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

paite: Jebuste, Amorte, Girgaste;
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

paite: Hivte, Arkate, Sinte;
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

paite: Arvadte, Zemarte, Hamathte asuang; huai nung in Kanaan namte akithehzakta uhi.
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

paite: Kanaante gamgi Zidon a kipan Gerar, Gaza, Sodom leh Gomorrah, Admah, Zeboim leh Lasa khua tan ahi.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

paite: Huaite, anamte dungzui zel leh apaute, agamte leh anamte lak ua dungzui zel in Ham suante ahi uh.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

paite: Shem, Eber ta tengteng suangpa, Japheth upa'n leng tate anei hi.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

paite: Shem tapate: Elam, Asshur, Arpakshad, Lud leh Aram ahi uh.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

paite: Aram tapate: Uz, Hul, Gether leh Mash ahi uh.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

paite: Arpakshad in tapa Shelah anei a; Shelah in tapa Eber anei hi.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

paite: Eber in tapa nih anei a: khat min Peleg ahi a, adam lai a leitung akikhen ziak in; anau min Joktan ahi.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

paite: Joktan in tapa Almodad, Seleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah;
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

paite: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah;
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

paite: Obal, Abimael, Sheba;
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

paite: Ophir, Havilah leh Jobab anei a; huai tengteng Joktan tapate ahi uh.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

paite: Atenna uh Mesha a kipan suahlam tang Sephar tan ahi.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

paite: Huaite Shem suante ahi ua; anamte dungzui zel leh apaute dungzui zel in, agamte ah leh achite dungzui zel in.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

paite: Huaite Noah suan namte ahi ua, asuante uh dungzui zel in achite uh lak ah; tuichim tun nung in huaite a kipan ahi a; lei a chi chih khenkhiak ahi uhi.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.
